caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers rendered in various shades of brown, suggesting a natural wood finish. The chest features two doors at the top, each with a central knob, and four hinges connecting them to the main body. Below the doors, there are eight drawers; the uppermost row has two smaller drawers side by side, each with a central knob, and the three subsequent rows each have one larger drawer spanning the width, also fitted with a single central knob. The chest stands on four short legs with slight inward curves at the base. The background is a light, off-white color, and the shadows on the left suggest a light source from the right. The overall composition is simple and geometric, with straight lines and right angles dominating the structure of the chest.
title: Shaker Cabinet
